title: Mass of an integral current: M_V(ω ↦ ∫_E ξ(ω) dμ) ≤ μ(E ∩ V) when |ξ| ≤ 1 a.e.
statement: Mass bound for a current given by integration against a measure. Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, X ∈ 𝒟_d(U), μ a measure on ℝ^P, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_d a function with values in d-vectors (MultiVector P d = continuous linear functionals on d-covectors), and E, V ⊆ ℝ^P arbitrary sets. Assume that for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every d-covector α, and that X(ω) = ∫_E ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) (Bochner integral with respect to μ⌞E). Then M_V(X) ≤ μ(E ∩ V) in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U d) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (E V : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, X ω = ∫ x in E, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ) → X.massOn V ≤ μ (E ∩ V)
